candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi temporal adverbs, conjunctions, and correlative words denoting time, condition, or limitation.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha) and its various conjunct forms and vowel combinations within Devanagari script.
This feature vector detects Hindi characters, sub-word suffixes, and common morphemes.
This vector represents fragments of words in Devanagari script, primarily capturing common sub-word tokens or character n-grams used in Hindi text tokenization.
This vector activates on various character fragments, symbols, and linguistic sub-tokens across different scripts.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and grammatical morphemes.
This vector represents Hindi vowel matras followed by a comma or punctuation mark.
This feature vector activates on common Devanagari conjunct consonants and Hindi syllable fragments.
These tokens represent fragments of text written in Devanagari script.
This vector represents common suffixes and roots in Hindi vocabulary.
